description: Time series of Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663) stock-token spreads for one symbol: 5-minute samples of the on-chain pool price (v3, with v4 cross-check), pool liquidity in USD, and the percentage spread versus the US-listed reference quote. Derived fields only; the reference quote itself is not included. Coverage starts 2026-10-23. The window ends at the latest available sample and can reach back up to 720 hours. Samples cover US market open and closed hours. For research and market-structure analysis of tokenized stocks.
name: rh-stock-spread-history
